scopeBasis: Provided chapter plan, textbook sections and teacher deck. The original course scope is preserved through the listed lessons.
officialCodeStatus: Not independently verified against a retrievable current official outcome register. No outcome codes have been invented. Confirm code-level mapping during division/Codex acceptance.

lessons.title: Chromosomes, DNA and chromosome sets
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish chromatin, chromosomes, homologous chromosomes and chromosome sets.

lessons.title: The cell cycle and DNA replication
lessons.learningGoal: Explain G1, S, G2, mitosis and cytokinesis, connecting DNA replication with later inheritance by daughter cells.

lessons.title: Reading chromosome number and DNA amount
lessons.learningGoal: Count chromosomes and chromatids through replication and separation, stating whether a count applies to a whole cell or one future nucleus.

lessons.title: Mitosis: chromosome movement through the stages
lessons.learningGoal: Trace prophase, metaphase, anaphase and telophase, connecting visible events with accurate chromosome distribution.

lessons.title: Cytokinesis, growth and tissue maintenance
lessons.learningGoal: Compare plant and animal cytokinesis, explain growth and repair, and distinguish normal cell-cycle control from uncontrolled division.

lessons.title: Meiosis I and separation of homologous chromosomes
lessons.learningGoal: Trace meiosis I and explain why separation of homologues produces haploid chromosome sets while chromatids remain paired.

lessons.title: Meiosis II and production of haploid cells
lessons.learningGoal: Trace meiosis II and compare chromosome sets, chromatid state and functional products in sperm and egg production.

lessons.title: Crossing over and independent assortment
lessons.learningGoal: Explain crossing over, independent assortment and random fertilization, keeping chromosome sets complete.

lessons.title: Comparing mitosis and meiosis
lessons.learningGoal: Compare replication, pairing, divisions, ploidy and genetic similarity in mitosis and meiosis.

lessons.title: Nondisjunction and chromosome abnormalities
lessons.learningGoal: Predict products of nondisjunction in meiosis I or II and distinguish aneuploidy from a change in whole chromosome sets.

lessons.title: Sexual and asexual reproductive strategies
lessons.learningGoal: Classify reproductive strategies from evidence, distinguish bacterial division from mitosis, and connect reproduction with genetic variation.

lessons.title: Life cycles and alternation of generations
lessons.learningGoal: Trace mitosis, meiosis and fertilization through haploid and diploid stages, including sporophytes, spores and gametophytes.
